metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1955 · Diabolique
metas.description: The wife and mistress of a loathed school principal plan to murder him with what they believe is the perfect alibi.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1956 · Invasion of the Body Snatchers
metas.description: A small-town doctor learns that the population of his community is being replaced by emotionless alien duplicates.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1954 · Godzilla
metas.description: After a dinosaur-like beast - awoken from undersea hibernation by atom bomb testing - ravages Tokyo, a scientist must decide if his similarly dangerous weapon should be used to destroy it.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1958 · Horror of Dracula
metas.description: When Jonathan Harker rouses the ire of Count Dracula for accepting a job at the vampire's castle under false pretenses, his friend Dr. Van Helsing pursues the predatory villain.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1954 · Them!
metas.description: The earliest atomic tests in New Mexico cause common ants to mutate into giant man-eating monsters that threaten civilization.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1958 · The Fly
metas.description: A scientist has a horrific accident when he tries to use his newly invented teleportation device.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1951 · The Thing from Another World
metas.description: Scientists and American Air Force officials fend off a bloodthirsty alien organism while at a remote arctic outpost.
